messages.subject: Image behind widgets
parts:
Hi,

Apologies if this question has been asked (and answered before) -- I'm new to Shiny and couldn't find anything that appeared to answer my question.

I'm wanting to create an app with simple geometric shapes (triangles, circles and squares) in a specific layout, each with (ideally) some sort of input field in them but, at a minimum, with the ability to include a text label which can be updated with the results of calculations. My guess (!) about how to do this in Shiny would be to draw a background image within a panel somewhere, and then overlay the widgets over it. I have no idea how I might go about that, however. Does anyone have any suggestions about how I might achieve this (or another approach which would work better)? I should mention that my css/html skills are very limited!

Thanks for any help!

Simon
